gates.reasons: Passes all six: metadata-supervised nuisance-subspace projection-to-clean-marginal (content untouched) has a defensible delta over attractor repair, learned invariance, concept-erasure, and prototype-snap TTA; privileged metadata is training-time only; held-out-factor pre-registration and the premise-killing diagnostic make it falsifiable and PC-defensible. Condition: the promised dedicated novelty sweep must run before writing.

A: surviving twist is RMA-style online env-latent estimation with a fixed two-rate filter instead of a learned encoder, in self-admitted crowded TTA space; novelty hinges on two-rate-vs-EMA, which its own diagnostic names as a kill condition. E: claimed axes 1 and 2 are the same perturbed rollouts re-sliced (aggregate SR vs per-timestep profile) and the few-shot axis is speculative since protocol demos are not photometrically perturbed, leaving <3 plausible distinct improvements. F: narrow photometric slice (conceded effect-size risk) plus filter-choice-level contribution will not survive a CoRL/RA-L PC in a crowded area.

A: with the schema basis conceded to MoS-VLA, the residual claim (kernel-ridge posterior + variance-gated abstention) is standard GP/selective-prediction machinery a reviewer will map to VINN-style nonparametric imitation plus ThriftyDAgger-style uncertainty gating; not affirmatively new. F: the repositioned headline concedes LoRA may win nominal few-shot SR, so the paper reads as an efficiency/application study of known components in a crowded few-shot-adaptation area.

A: everything beyond S1's core is conceded-known machinery (S3's kernel head), so the case rests on combination novelty ('nothing found combining') with no dedicated audit — not affirmatively strong on its own. F: two-stage system with double premise risk and stage-2 novelty conceded invites the review outcome 'drop stage 2, resubmit as the S1 paper'; the candidate's own fallback plan to split into two papers concedes it is not one contribution.

debates.attack_summary: The nuisance subspace is unidentifiable as specified: clean LIBERO data has constant camera pose and lighting, so the "linearly predicts rendering metadata" regression has a near-constant target (and the only varying metadata, wrist-cam pose, is task content, poisoning the split). Any rescue requires factor-varied re-rendering, which collapses the core "disentanglement-not-augmentation" differentiator — and the proposal's own diagnostic (ii) already trains the repair on {lighting, distractor} perturbations, contradicting its C7 defense. Worse, the pre-registered held-out win is staked on occlusion and viewpoint-appearance, factors a low-rank linear appearance-subspace projection mechanistically cannot repair (occlusion deletes content tokens; viewpoint shuffles token correspondence). Residual novelty is thin: metadata-supervised linear nuisance projection is INLP/LEACE-style concept erasure plus a snap-to-marginal, unacknowledged in nearest_prior_art.
debates.verdict_reasoning: S1's survival case rested entirely on by-construction differentiators (clean-data-only training, held-out-factor transfer, protected content subspace), and each dissolves under inspection: the training premise is incoherent as written, the held-out factors sit outside the mechanism's reach, and the "content preserved" axis is vacuous against anything but the C21 strawman. What remains is a linear-projection variant of appearance augmentation whose cheap diagnostic can pass on weak proxies (lighting-only kNN distance) while the headline claim fails — a textbook false-survivor risk, so the kill is warranted despite the low diagnostic cost.

debates.attack_summary: Identifiability contradiction at the core: supervised nuisance disentanglement requires variation in the supervised labels, but clean LIBERO rollouts have essentially constant camera pose and lighting per task, so "camera-pose bin / light params" probes fit on clean-only data are degenerate — P_nuis is unlearnable without re-rendering varied lighting/cameras, and the moment you re-render variants you are doing perturbation augmentation with extra steps, collapsing the claimed "structural, by-construction" edge over the corruption-augmented baseline (both now see the same factor variation) and grazing the killed sim-re-render direction. Second front: the pre-registered held-out-factor win has no causal path — occlusion and viewpoint displace features largely OUTSIDE a lighting/distractor-fit nuisance subspace, so the off-manifold gate either never fires (repair does nothing) or snaps to an irrelevant clean centroid; meanwhile viewpoint entangles with content (object positions are task-relevant), and "distractor as nuisance" directly contradicts the "novel objects live in content, preserved BY CONSTRUCTION" guarantee, which anyway only holds under exact factor orthogonality that the concept-erasure literature (INLP/LEACE) shows real features never satisfy. Novelty: the mechanism is linear-probe concept erasure plus clean-statistics matching plus test-time feature restoration — the nearest_prior_art field omits INLP/LEACE and style-statistic/feature-restoration lines that are closer than the DRIBO/TTT strawmen it cites.
debates.verdict_reasoning: The proposal is internally inconsistent: it simultaneously claims clean-data-only training (its whole differentiator vs augmentation), a nuisance subspace supervised by camera-pose labels, and an eval that holds out viewpoint — these cannot all be true, and every resolution either destroys the differentiator or leaves the headline factors (viewpoint -91pt, occlusion) outside the repairable subspace. Its own diagnostic would not catch this because diagnostic (i) tests only lighting, the one factor where the linear-offset story plausibly works, so a passing diagnostic still funnels a GPU-month into an eval with no mechanism for its pre-registered win. With the by-construction claims falsified in principle and the residual mechanism reducible to known concept-erasure plus manifold-snapping, the surviving contribution is too thin for CoRL/TMLR.

debates.attack_summary: Of the three claimed dimensions, only one survives inspection: (a) the few-shot axis has an empty causal path — LIBERO demos are rendered under fixed camera/lighting, so there is near-zero nuisance variance for the content code to remove, and (b) the novel-object axis is a non-regression (the gate is ~identity in-distribution, so it merely matches the frozen baseline, beating only the internal C21 strawman). The remaining axis — held-out-factor robustness — targets the mildest LIBERO-Plus slice (photometrics), not the -91pt viewpoint or -88pt init-state collapses, and its transfer claim is mechanistically implausible: occlusion introduces content-like structure and viewpoint is a high-rank geometric warp, neither of which lands in a low-rank subspace fit to lighting/camera-bin labels. Worse, the flagship "by construction" content protection is false — observed color = reflectance x illumination, so any linear subspace that predicts light parameters necessarily carries object-color directions, and snapping it to the clean marginal can recolor novel objects, reproducing exactly the C21 failure the fix claims to structurally eliminate.
debates.verdict_reasoning: S1 realistically moves ~1 of the >=3 required dimensions, and that one is a small photometric slice of LIBERO-Plus using privileged sim rendering metadata with no real-robot story — workshop/short-RA-L scope, not CoRL/T-RO main track. Its anti-augmentation positioning is also internally inconsistent (the diagnostic itself trains on {lighting,distractor} perturbed renders, since clean data has constant metadata and cannot define the subspace), and the projection-out-nuisance mechanism sits close to known linear concept erasure (INLP/LEACE-style), leaving a thin delta that hangs entirely on an improbable held-out-factor transfer result. A borderline-significance idea with a falsified by-construction guarantee does not justify the downstream GPU-month; kill.
